gags.gag: paper plane lands on a tennis court
gags.description: Top-down green tennis court on tangerine clay; a paper plane descends with its shadow, touches down on 'court' and skids with skid marks; signs COURT 3 and NOW LANDING: PAPER PLANE
whips across the tab bar and a mosaic of open-tab previews, new tab pops on each beat
jump cuts between tab-bar close-ups and the tab mosaic
cuts with paper flashes on beats 3 and 4

Dark storm sky, clouds, fizz rain, a lightning bolt on every beat; the potted plant sways, grows a step and sprouts a new leaf on each flash (+1 LEAF chips), sunglasses and a grin on the pot; THUNDERSTORM WARNING bar and a HOUSEPLANT STATUS: THRIVING card
whips and punches over the tab mosaic

Weather-radar hurricane spiral rotating around a calm eye; lemons, cups, shoes and boxes fly around it; the lemonade stand sits in the eye with a LEMONADE sign and a swinging OPEN sign, STILL OPEN sticker, HURRICANE WARNING bar

The same paper plane from court 3 flies left to right across the top of the window over the tab bar, towing a mustard banner GOOD VIBES 4 SALE; blue sky tab below with clouds and little glyph customers bouncing
three whips in a row, tabs now glyph-only
eighth-note jump cuts with heavy shake
wide tilted framings with a punch per beat so the DebrisLayer paint dots landing over the desktop are visible; no own paint drawn

whip out, then the camera rushes back to REST_POSE while the window settles onto HOOK_WINDOW and the glovebox icon wiggles on 'glovebox'; lyric card at the top where the hook type will sit; hard cut on the downbeat into hook3

promotionCandidates: Sign (sticker label) is generic and useful to every section
notes: One BrowserWindow throughout, always tabs=tabCountAt(frame) (3 -> 160, slivers by the end). Gag tab indices are derived from tabCountAt at each gag bar's downbeat. Last frame is exactly REST_POSE with the window at HOOK_WINDOW (flow tab mode, 160 slivers), icon at ICON_HOME visible below; hook3 swaps to symmetric tabs on the cut. Shot list with beat-relative timing in Section.tsx (SHOTS).
